question: Your framework app is client-only. One route now needs server rendering. What do the docs describe?
options: Turn on server rendering just for that route
Switch the whole app to server rendering
Move that page to a separate app
say: Your framework app is client only. One route now needs server rendering. What do the docs describe?
explanation: These frameworks let you add server rendering per route, when it makes sense. You can start client-only and opt in on individual routes without rewriting your app.
explainSay: Turn it on just for that route. Frameworks let you opt into server rendering route by route.
